en.capPending: Pending upstream support — the official client does not bridge this capability yet (prompt templates and resource subscriptions remain deferred).
en.derivedNote: Connection status and reconnect counts come from the upstream mcp/status seam; without observed upstream data, connection fields read "unknown" and the rest are config and tool-registry facts.
en.diag_auth401: The server rejected the credentials (HTTP 401) — check the Authorization header or token.
en.diag_auth403: The server denied access (HTTP 403) — the credential is valid but lacks permission.
en.diag_commandNotFound: The configured command was not found — install the package or fix the executable path.
en.diag_commandSpawnFailed: The server process failed to start or exited — check the command line, its arguments, and the server's own logs.
en.diag_connectionDropped: The connection dropped mid-session — the server may have crashed or restarted.
en.diag_connectionRefused: The server refused the connection — start the server or check the host/port in the URL.
en.diag_dns: The server hostname did not resolve — check the DNS name in the URL and the network.
en.diag_entryFailed: The cordis row failed to mount — read the loader diagnostics, then fix the row and reload.
en.diag_path404: The endpoint path returned 404 — check the URL path (e.g. /mcp).
en.diag_permission: A permission error occurred — check file permissions, PATH access, and whether the command is executable.
en.diag_rateLimit: The server rate-limited the client — wait, or reduce the reconnect/request rate.
en.diag_reconnectExhausted: The reconnect budget is exhausted and the client has given up — fix the root cause, then reload the row (the web surface hot-reloads cordis.patch.yml edits) or restart.
en.diag_reconnectWaiting: The client is waiting in reconnect backoff — it will retry automatically; fix the root cause to stop the cycle.
en.diag_timeout: A request timed out — the server may be overloaded, or the URL may be wrong. Check toolCallTimeoutMs if calls are slow.
en.empty: This profile configures no official MCP servers (@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client rows).
en.fieldFailFast: failOnStartupError (fail the mount on startup errors)
en.healthNone: No known failure pattern detected from the observable facts.
en.healthPending: Exit code / stderr tail: pending upstream support (the official client does not expose process diagnostics yet).
en.patchFileUnknown: The profile patch path is unknown (no baseUrl) — the fragment can only be copied.
en.patchHint: This console writes the profile patch layer by APPENDING operations (existing content is never rewritten), and backs up the file before every write.
en.probeEmpty: No probes yet. Start one with the mcp_probe tool.
en.removeConfirm: Removal = appending an `- id:` + `disabled: true` override operation (the patch vocabulary has no remove). The row stays in the file and can be re-enabled anytime.
en.resourceEmpty: No resource entries returned (or this server exposes none).
en.resourceHint: Read-only browse through the official list_mcp_resources / list_mcp_resource_templates / read_mcp_resource tools; results are shown only here and never enter model context.
en.trialApprovalNote: Approval-style calls need the current session to be inside an open turn; otherwise they fail closed.
en.trialDisabled: The trial console is disabled (config.trialEnabled: false).
en.trialHint: Calls run through the official tool pipeline (permission policy and approval stay in force); results are shown only here and never enter model context.
en.trialNoTools: This server has no registered tools — it may be disconnected or its sync failed.
en.trialTruncated: The result exceeded the display cap and was truncated.
en.writeDisabled: Writes are disabled (config.writeEnabled: false) — the fragment can only be copied.
en.writeDone: Written to {file} (backup: {backup}). The web surface hot-reloads cordis.patch.yml edits; other surfaces restart.
en.writeRequiresConfirm: Writing needs confirmation: review the fragment above, then press "Confirm write".
